verses: David gathered all the princes of Israel, the tribal leaders, the captains of the companies who served the king by rotation, the captains over the thousands, the captains over the hundreds, the stewards over all the king's wealth and property and that of his sons, the officers, the mighty men, and all the valiant men, to Jerusalem.

Then King David stood and said, "Listen, my brothers and my people: as for me, I have in my heart a desire to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and I have prepared for the building."
But God said to me, "You must not build a house for my name, because you have been a man of war and have shed blood."

However, the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the members of my father's house to be king over Israel forever: for he chose Judah to be the ruler, and from the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among my father's sons he chose me to be king over all Israel.
Of all my sons— for the LORD has given me many sons— he chose my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the LORD's kingdom over Israel.
He said to me, "Solomon, your son, will build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him as my son, and I will be his father."
Moreover I will establish his kingdom forever, if he remains faithful to keep my commandments and my judgments, as he does today.

Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and before our God, keep and seek all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance for your children forever.

# And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and a willing mind: for the LORD searches all hearts and understands all the thoughts and intentions; if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
Pay attention now; for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong and do it.
# Then David gave his son Solomon the pattern of the porch, the houses, the treasuries, the upper chambers, the inner rooms, and the place of the mercy seat,

and the pattern of everything he had received by the spirit: the courts of the house of the LORD, all the surrounding chambers, the treasuries of the house of God, and the treasuries of the dedicated items.
Also for the shifts of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the service vessels in the house of the LORD.
He gave gold by weight for items of gold, for all instruments of every kind of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service.

Including the weight for the gold lampstands and their gold lamps, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and for the silver lampstands by weight, both for the lampstand and also for its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand.
And by weight he gave gold for the shewbread tables, for each table; and likewise silver for the silver tables.
Also pure gold for the food hooks, the bowls, and the cups; and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for each basin; and likewise silver by weight for each silver basin.
And for the altar of incense he gave refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the cherubim's chariot, whose wings spread out and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand on me, even all the works of this pattern.

And David said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous, and do it; do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God—my God—will be with you; he will not fail you or forsake you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD."

And, look, the shifts of the priests and the Levites will be with you for all the service of the house of God; and with you will be every willing skilled person for any kind of workmanship, for any kind of service; also the princes and all the people will be completely under your command.
